ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web shown in the diagram, which organism is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows several labeled organisms, including “Cane grass” at the top-left, “Cricket” near the center, and other consumers such as lizards and snakes. There is an arrow leading from Cane grass toward the cricket. Reasoning: In a food web, a producer is a plant or photosynthetic organism that provides energy to consumers. Since Cane grass is the plant shown feeding into the food web, it is the producer.
